'''Crawling corpse torsos''' can be found in the fourth room of the [[Lumbridge Catacombs]] which can only be entered after completing [[The Blood Pact]] quest. They were created by [[Dragith Nurn]], a now undead necromancer, during his experiments with stolen corpses.

This is one of the monsters that drop [[Mask part 3]], which can be used with the 4 other parts to create the [[Mask of Dragith Nurn]].
